arStrings.szText:
While you have {c_important}{u}Crackling Energy{/u}{/c} charges, you deal {c_number}[{SF_6} * 100|x%|]{/c} increased damage. This amount increases by {c_number}[{SF_3} * 100|x%|]{/c} per {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} Intelligence you have up to {c_number}[{SF_5} * 100|x%|]{/c}. When you reach full charges, your {c_important}{u}Crackling Energy{/u}{/c} damage is increased by {c_number}[SF_7]{/c} times this amount until you run out of charges.

Current Bonus: {c_number}[{SF_4} * 100|x%|]{/c}
